title: Amazon's cloud unit hit by at least two outages involving AI tools, FT says
title_zh: 英国《金融时报》称，亚马逊云部门至少遭遇两次涉及人工智能工具的故障
summary: Amazon's ‌cloud ‌unit has suffered ​at least two outages ‌stemming ⁠from errors involving ⁠its own ​AI ​tools, ​the Financial ‌Times reported on Friday, citing ‌people ​familiar ​with ​the ‌matter. Reuters could not ​immediately ​verify the ​report.
summary_zh: 英国《金融时报》周五援引知情人士的话报道称，亚马逊的云部门因涉及其自己的人工智能工具的错误而遭受了至少两次中断。路透社无法立即验证该报道。

title: Tesla cuts price of Cybertruck model Cyberbeast in US
title_zh: 特斯拉在美国下调 Cyber​​truck 车型 Cyber​​beast 的售价
summary: Feb 19 (Reuters) - Tesla has reduced the price of Cyberbeast, its most-expensive Cybertruck pickup truck model, to $99,990 from $114,990 in the United States, according to pricing information on the
summary_zh: 路透 2 月 19 日 - 根据定价信息显示，特斯拉已将其最昂贵的 Cyber​​truck 皮卡车型 Cyber​​beast 在美国的售价从 114,990 美元下调至 99,990 美元。

title: Tesla unveils cheaper Cybertruck model in US, cuts Cyberbeast price
title_zh: 特斯拉在美国推出更便宜的 Cyber​​truck 车型，降低 Cyber​​beast 价格
summary: Tesla unveiled a new cheaper Cybertruck model in the ‌U.S. on Thursday, priced at $59,990, making ‌the dual-motor all-wheel-drive version its "most affordable" Cybertruck yet.
summary_zh: 特斯拉在美国推出了一款更便宜的新型 Cyber​​truck 车型周四，售价 59,990 美元，使双电机全轮驱动版本成为迄今为止“最实惠”的 Cyber​​truck。

title: Nvidia close to investing $30 billion in OpenAI's mega funding round, source says
title_zh: 消息人士称，Nvidia 即将在 OpenAI 的大型融资轮中投资 300 亿美元
summary: Nvidia is close to finalizing a $30 billion investment in OpenAI, as ‌the chipmaker moves to take a stake in one of ‌its largest customers, a person familiar with the matter said.
summary_zh: 一位知情人士表示，Nvidia 即将敲定对 OpenAI 的 300 亿美元投资，这家芯片制造商将入股其最大客户之一。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as US-Iran tensions rise, PCE inflation looms
title_zh: 今日股市：美伊紧张局势加剧，个人消费支出通胀迫在眉睫，道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨
summary: Wall Street is approaching the end to a contentious earnings season defined by an AI sell-off.
summary_zh: 华尔街因人工智能抛售而引发争议的财报季即将结束。

title: Meta cuts stock awards by 5% for most employees, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，Meta 将大多数员工的股票奖励削减了 5%
summary: Meta reduced its annual distribution of stock options by about 5% for most of its ‌staff, as CEO Mark Zuckerberg ploughs billions of dollars ‌into its artificial intelligence goals, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周四报道，随着首席执行官马克扎克伯格将数十亿美元投入其人工智能目标，Meta 将其大多数员工的年度股票期权分配减少了约 5%。

title: Why Tesla is facing a retail vs. institutional investor tug-of-war
title_zh: 为什么特斯拉面临散户投资者与机构投资者的拉锯战
summary: Institutional investors have been selling their Tesla (TSLA) stakes, while retail investors are piling in. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian jumps on Market Domination Overtime to chat with Josh Lipton about what's driving this recent trend.
summary_zh: 机构投资者一直在抛售特斯拉 (TSLA) 股份，而散户投资者则纷纷涌入。雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 跳上市场统治加班节目，与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 讨论了推动这一近期趋势的因素。

title: Today in tech: OpenAI's new funding, Nvidia comes for AMD & Intel
title_zh: 今日科技：OpenAI 获得新资金，Nvidia 收购 AMD 和英特尔
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley comes on Market Domination to break down the day's leading and trending tech stories.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 在《市场统治》节目中剖析了当天的领先和热门科技故事。

title: Why US markets are ignoring 'pretty, pretty good' Q4 earnings
title_zh: 为什么美国市场忽视“非常非常好的”第四季度收益
summary: While earnings season has seen a strong showing from industry leaders, why does it seem like the market (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) is ignoring all the positive results and revenue growth?
summary_zh: 虽然行业领导者在财报季表现强劲，但为什么市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）似乎忽略了所有积极的业绩和收入增长？
